label: Diagram 2.5
caption: Diagram 2.5 Ground or basement storey exit into an enclosed space
description: The image is a section drawing with a green title band at the bottom reading Diagram 2.5 Ground or basement storey exit into an enclosed space. Top left shows See para 2.10. The section depicts two building blocks on a ground line: a taller left block with a pitched roof and a lower right block with a flat roof. A horizontal dashed line above both is labelled Mean roof level. On the far left, two short vertical double-headed arrows are each labelled Equal. A vertical green dimension labelled x spans the taller block from a lower dashed baseline to the mean roof level, and a vertical green dimension labelled y spans the lower block. To the right, a horizontal green dimension labelled x.min. runs from the taller block's wall to a vertical line, and a horizontal green dimension labelled y.min. runs from the lower block's wall to a flight of steps. A vertical line on the right, with a short filled vertical bar at its top, is labelled Enclosure to space e.g. a wall, fence, building. Right-side text reads: Where escape from a dwellinghouse is to an enclosed space with exit only possible through other buildings (e.g. a courtyard or back garden), the length of the space should exceed whichever is the greater of the following. a. The height of the dwellinghouse above ground level (x). b. Where a rear extension is provided, the height of the extension (y).
